Damaging winds with a squall line moved through the community of Rockwood in the wake of a tornado that passed through the community just prior to the strong winds and heavy rains.

These winds were embedded in the large squall line that moved through the Heartland, and the winds produced a large swath of damage across the region. Minor roof damage and broken tree limbs were reported in the small town of Valera.

This is a continuation of the strong downburst winds associated with an intense squall line that produced additional damage in the wake of a tornado that moved through the area just prior to the onset of the strong winds.
